articles.title: Hyundai tests AI agent commerce on JPMorgan’s Kinexys blockchain
articles.snippet: The exploration of AI agents with JPMorgan builds on Hyundai’s recent stablecoin-based cross-border remittance pilot.

articles.title: Hong Kong, Swift test tokenized deposits as banks chase stablecoin-style speed
articles.snippet: Hong Kong and Swift expanded their efforts to connect tokenized bank deposits across currencies, building on earlier work involving digital central bank money.

articles.title: Tether invokes The Big Short in swipe at S&P over USDT reserve risks
articles.snippet: S&P Global made no downward adjustment in its latest Stablecoin Stability Assessment, as 5 is the lowest available score.

articles.title: World Bank partners with Circle, Citi to explore stablecoins for payments
articles.snippet: The initiative builds on the World Bank’s existing blockchain platform, which aims to create more fund traceability for investments in developing countries.

articles.title: Eastern Europe crypto flows fall 7.9% as Ukraine draws $12B in stablecoins
articles.snippet: Chainalysis found that Eastern Europe recorded the steepest decline in crypto activity of any region, while cross-border stablecoin transfers to Ukraine continued amid the ongoing war.
